hook: SCR renumbers *six* trains from Superfast to Mail/Express
hook_b: SCR renumbers *six* trains from Superfast to Mail/Express
tldr: South Central Railway will renumber six trains and recategorise them from Superfast to Mail/Express from Jan 2-3, 2027.

beats.what: Hyderabad–CST Mumbai, Kacheguda–Kumta and Narasapur–Nagarsol pairs get new 17xxx numbers.
beats.why: SCR is revising the category of these services from Superfast to Mail/Express.
beats.care: If you book these trains for January 2027 or later, search by the new number.

cards.q: Do you search trains by number or by name?

qs: Do fares change when a train moves from Superfast to Mail/Express?

facts.t: The renumbering covers *3 pairs*: Hyderabad–Mumbai, Kacheguda–Kumta and Narasapur–Nagarsol.

viz.verdict: Bookings after the date use new numbers
Same train, new number and Mail/Express category

watch: New numbers apply from Jan 2, 2027; Nagarsol–Narasapur from Jan 3.
twist: All six also drop from the Superfast category to Mail/Express, per SCR.
